title: Each client form files into its own list, and a request can be cancelled
description: Every request from a client form becomes a task in that form's own list in Client Requests. The list can no longer be changed when approving, in the form's settings, or by moving the task later. A wrong-form submission can now be cancelled instead of rejected.
items: Cancel request asks for a reason, with presets for wrong form, duplicate and withdrawn
The client is emailed the reason
Cancelled is not counted as a rejection
pending: Needs the P16 database updates applied before it works.
